title: Rav Chama, Colleague of the Rabbis
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in the Jerusalem Talmud: Rosh Hashanah 1:1, folio 4b; Megillah 1:7; Yevamot, chapter 3, end of halakhah 1. Mavo HaYerushalmi writes that he belonged to the third generation in the Land of Israel.[^1]

notes.text: The actual Jerusalem Talmud paragraphs at Rosh Hashanah 1:1, Megillah 1:7 and Yevamot 3:1 fully write Rabbi Chama, colleague of the rabbis. Hyman’s heading explicitly says Rav and is retained as his source-specific title. The third-generation placement is his report from Mavo HaYerushalmi, not a new chronological admission.
